candidate_windows.window_text: We initialize both FLAME and FLAME-Opt-RM with PaLM-2-24B (Anil et al., 2023), instruction-tuned on the Flan collection (Longpre et al., 2023), and train for $30\mathrm{K}$ and $5\mathrm{K}$ steps, respectively. FLAME is further fine-tuned for 50 steps to create FLAME-RM. Our models are trained using T5X (Roberts et al., 2023) with the Adam optimizer (Kingma and Ba, 2015), a learning rate of 0.0001, and a dropout rate of 0.05. FLAME is trained on 256 Cloud TPU chips with a batch size of 32, whereas FLAME-RM and FLAME-Opt-RM use 128 Cloud TPU chips with a batch size of 8. $^{12}$
